name: instrumented-repeat
kind: single matched repeat; descriptive comparison, not a general uplift estimate

timing.reason: Elapsed durations are from task-runtime metadata. Token counts are not exposed. The tool does not expose temperature or a random seed.

directional_observation: In this pair, the instructed run passed the complete-output, scope-applicability and test-level rationale assertions that the control missed. Both runs fixed the seeded bug and passed their focused tests.
finding: The fixed-model pair provides a positive directional signal for repository instructions in this case. It does not establish a general causal uplift: there is one run per arm, the runtime does not expose every generation parameter, and common platform/user policies remain in both arms.
gaps: One task per arm does not estimate run-to-run variance.
Temperature and random seed are not exposed by the task-agent tool.
Token counts and provider-side model telemetry are not exposed.
Common platform/developer/user-level instructions remain active in both arms.
No engine/BPMN, live store or real-provider integration test was run.
